svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Architecture: hub-and-spoke
svg.desc: One hub project hosts the API. Managed projects emit Antigravity, Gemini Platform and Gemini Enterprise logs to an aggregated sink feeding BigQuery and Pub/Sub. The API and enforcer price usage with the Cloud Billing Catalog and enforce with IAM Deny v2, Org Policy and Cloud Quotas.
svg.text: One installation in the hub project governs every managed project
Shared state for API and enforcer
Log Router: project, folder or org
IAM Deny, Org Policy and quotas applied
per project, folder or org; 403 in 1-2 min
